messages.subject: Query about paired analysis scenario
parts:
Setup: GenomeWide_SNP_6 array, tumor vs. normal (equal number of
samples), Copy number variation analysis.

Q1.If I want to do a paired analysis (case vs control), do I add label
in the filenames as case and control or do I upload them seperately at
the defining CEL set:

cs<- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("......").

Q2.I see that further into the analysis steps "Identification of copy-
number regions (CNRs)", for paired analysis we have two objects ces1,
ces 2. Where do these objects originate from if initially we are
putting in all the samples together?

Thanks

Manisha

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Query about paired analysis scenario
parts:
Hi Manisha,
 
You appear to be consulting the vignette for Total Copy Number Analysis, whereas in your case you actually want to do _paired_ total copy number analysis.  If you read the documentation carefully at
 
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/paired-total-copy-number-analysis
 
this should answer both of your questions.  Note that you won't have to worry about the two separate chip types with the SNP 6.0 array.  Just set up the matrix of paired samples as is done there.
 
Cheers,
 
Ken
